findings.title: Supported nested inventory prevents committed death from reaching playable respawn
findings.trigger: Ordinary nonexempt character above level 8 with a vocation, no Adventurer protection, no regular blessings and no Amulet of Loss dies carrying main backpack -> bag -> item.
findings.impact: The death and pending respawn have committed, but selected backpack loss cannot finish. Fresh admission, reconnect and departed-owner recovery repeat the refusal. No duplication or irreversible loss of contents is established.
findings.proof: Death selection includes the main container independently of tree shape; zero-blessing container loss is 1000/1000. A subsequent writer rejects nested descendants before its terminal receipt. Admission and the pending-respawn deletion guard require all such receipts. SQL0531 mirrors the restriction; SQL0630 does not remove it.
findings.reproduction: Specified native SQL fixture: create supported nested tree through real owner, commit unprotected death, observe selected root and failed item receipt, pending respawn and both admission refusals; compare flat control. Not executed.
findings.proposed_fix: Support the full legal tree in both death custody writer and SQL proofs, retaining frozen selection and idempotency. Include recovery of existing incomplete receipts; do not clear or skip obligations.
findings.verification: Primary durability-economy auditor; independent gameplay auditor in verification-dur-003.md; lead reread the refusal, selection, retry and admission chain.

findings.title: Loyalty or proficiency magic bonuses reject otherwise valid self/native/conjure casts
findings.trigger: A current legitimate player has a nonzero loyalty/proficiency effect on final qualified magic and uses an affected self/native/conjure route. Example fixture: raw magic 30 with loyalty 3600 projects 31 without other adjustments.
findings.impact: Affected casts are rejected before resolution. Ordinary combat path is outside this finding; no cost/item loss was established.
findings.proof: Raw build/cache binding passes before qualification. Qualified caster includes loyalty and proficiency, but affected equality gates compare with a raw-plus-condition/Wheel projection. Real dispatch installs those bonuses and invokes the gates.
findings.reproduction: Use existing admitted native fixture, otherwise valid Light/self spell, and nonzero loyalty or +2 proficiency magic; expect success but observe Rejected. Include zero-bonus, native and conjure controls. Fixture values were inspected, not executed.
findings.proposed_fix: Use one authoritative effective-stat projection for the consistency checks while preserving the separate raw-build binding. Cover all sibling gates.
findings.verification: Primary gameplay auditor; independent durability-economy auditor in verification-gp-001.md; lead reread exact projections and gates.

findings.evidence: Static operation-size, production caller and retry proof. Actual mTLS/SQL publication not run.
findings.title: Valid V2 guild/death snapshots exceed an incorrectly shared HTTP envelope cap
findings.trigger: Configured public publisher serializes a valid guild/death body above the 10,240-byte generic request-envelope allowance but within its declared 393,216/32,768-byte operation body bound.
findings.impact: Request fails before write, snapshot is not acknowledged and retries; public views can stay stale. No authoritative game-data loss or gameplay outage established.
findings.proof: V2 encoder accepts per-operation size; production mTLS sink uses the shared cap without a matching V2 override; success-only acknowledgement retains the failed outbox snapshot.
findings.reproduction: Encode a valid sorted guild snapshot above the generic envelope threshold; real isolated mTLS sink should deliver but currently returns CapacityExceeded before write. Add exact/below-bound controls and deaths equivalent. Not executed.
findings.proposed_fix: Use declared per-operation body caps plus bounded header allowance for both V2 operations and test encoder-to-transport boundaries.
findings.verification: Session worker initial observation; lead independently opened and traced the full production publication route in public-projection-finding.md.
